note.question: How do optimality guarantees on short-form video platforms affect adaptive data acquisition for personalized recommendations?
note.overview: The recent surge in the popularity of short-form video (SFV) on digital platforms has led to massive numbers of videos and ever-evolving topics. As a result, the task of making personalized recommendations has become increasingly challenging. We introduce a new pure exploration problem on SFV platforms: finding a ([Formula: see text])-optimal set that includes all recommendations within the [Formula: see text]-optimality gap and that excludes those beyond the [Formula: see text]-optimality gap relative to the best arm with a capacity limit of K.
